help_msg:
📄 Send me a message, a photo or a document. I will ask you which email address to send it to.
After confirmation, everything is sent in a single message.
Use /history to see the last sent messages.
⏳ Limit: 20 messages per minutes per user.
💎 VIP users have NO message limit!
To get VIP access, contact @cstrim

Available commands:
/start – Start the bot
/help – Show this help message
/history – Show your last sent messages
/cancel – Cancel the current operation
/about – About the bot
/lang – Change the language
/vip – Show VIP bonuses (if you are VIP)
/myid – Show your user ID
